cases.prompt: Architect a complex DeFi lending protocol using Solidity smart contracts, deploy them to an Ethereum testnet, and build a React frontend that securely interacts with user wallets.
cases.title: Full-Stack Decentralized App (dApp)

cases.prompt: Have the agent crawl digitized archives of 18th-century maritime logs to trace the exact route and cargo manifests of a specific lost merchant ship, compiling the findings into an academic paper.
cases.title: Autonomous Historical Researcher

cases.prompt: Build a multimodal system that simultaneously analyzes a user's facial micro-expressions, vocal tonality, and text input to accurately predict their emotional state and adjust its own conversational tone accordingly.
cases.title: Real-time Emotion Parsing AI

cases.prompt: Give the agent a $100 budget and an AWS account, and have it autonomously research a market gap, code a SaaS product, set up the landing page, and run targeted ads to acquire its first paying customer.
cases.title: AI-Driven Startup Founder

cases.prompt: Write an entire deep learning framework from scratch in C (similar to PyTorch but minimal), implementing backpropagation, matrix multiplication, and GPU acceleration via CUDA.
cases.title: Custom Machine Learning Framework

cases.prompt: Ingest the entire U.S. tax code and employ formal logic verification to autonomously discover contradictions or unpatched loopholes that could theoretically allow for zero corporate tax liability.
cases.title: Automated Legal Loophole Finder

cases.prompt: Build a simulation where thousands of distinct species (plants, herbivores, carnivores) evolve over millions of simulated years, dynamically mutating their traits based on environmental pressures.
cases.title: Procedural Ecosystem Simulator

cases.prompt: Take a massive, unmaintained COBOL banking system from the 1980s and safely translate it into a modern Java/Spring Boot microservices architecture without losing a single cent in transaction precision.
cases.title: Autonomous Codebase Modernizer

cases.prompt: Ingest live camera feeds of an NBA game, analyze player formations and fatigue levels, and autonomously output optimal offensive play calls to the coach's tablet in real-time.
cases.title: Real-time Sports Strategy Engine

cases.prompt: Feed the AI the last 5 years of research papers on Alzheimer's disease, and have it synthesize the data to propose a highly novel, chemically viable drug compound and the methodology to test it.
cases.title: Automated Scientific Hypothesis Generator

cases.prompt: Give the agent the company's maximum budget and SLAs, and have it email back and forth with 10 different SaaS vendors to negotiate the lowest possible price for enterprise licenses.
cases.title: Autonomous Negotiation of Vendor Contracts

cases.prompt: Write the embedded software that takes raw nerve impulses from a patient's amputated limb and translates them into precise, highly dexterous movements for a robotic hand.
cases.title: AI-Driven Cybernetic Prosthetic Controller

cases.prompt: Build a crawler that safely navigates Tor hidden services, scrapes forums for mentions of a specific corporate entity, and builds a threat intelligence graph of potential incoming cyberattacks.
cases.title: Automated Deep Web Intelligence Gatherer

cases.prompt: Invent a completely new paradigm of programming (neither object-oriented, functional, nor procedural), define its rules, write a compiler, and build a complex web server using only this new paradigm.
cases.title: Custom Programming Paradigm

cases.prompt: Write the AI for a Mars rover that must autonomously explore terrain, identify scientifically valuable rocks, and manage its own solar battery levels with a 20-minute communication delay to Earth.
cases.title: Autonomous Planetary Rover Logic

cases.prompt: Have the AI ingest hours of Dave Chappelle and John Mulaney specials, and autonomously write a 15-minute stand-up routine with perfect pacing, callback jokes, and cultural relevance.
cases.title: AI-Generated Stand-up Comedy Routine

cases.prompt: Build an agent that monitors Zillow for undervalued properties, automatically runs rehab cost estimations using contractor APIs, and auto-generates cash offer letters to the sellers within 5 minutes of listing. 90. **Custom High-Frequency Trading Protocol:** Write a networking protocol optimized for FPGA hardware that shaves microseconds off trade execution times by restructuring the TCP headers and utilizing custom packet routing.
cases.title: Automated Real Estate Flipper

cases.prompt: Create a system that monitors a live political debate, transcribes the audio, autonomously searches historical records and databases, and outputs a verified "True/False/Misleading" verdict on statements within 10 seconds.
cases.title: Autonomous Fact-Checking Engine

cases.prompt: Build a tool that takes a desired phenotypic change in an organism (e.g., drought resistance in wheat) and autonomously designs the exact CRISPR-Cas9 guide RNA sequence required to make the edit.
cases.title: AI-Driven Gene Editing Designer

cases.prompt: Deploy a swarm of 50 AI agents that can handle thousands of simultaneous customer service chats in 20 different languages, capable of processing refunds and updating shipping addresses autonomously.
cases.title: Automated Multi-lingual Customer Support Swarm

cases.prompt: Write an application that doesn't just compose music, but dynamically alters the tempo, volume, and emotional intensity of a pre-written score in real-time based on the live biofeedback (heart rate) of the audience.
cases.title: Autonomous Film Score Conductor

cases.prompt: Build an AI system that manages the entire lifecycle of returned e-commerce products, autonomously deciding whether an item should be restocked, refurbished, recycled, or liquidated based on market value and condition analysis.
cases.title: Automated Reverse Supply Chain Logistics

cases.prompt: Have the agent synthesize the works of Kant, Nietzsche, and modern quantum physics to write a 300-page original philosophical treatise proposing a new ethical framework for artificial superintelligence.
cases.title: AI-Generated Philosophical Treatise

cases.prompt: Write the navigation and object-recognition logic for a submarine drone exploring the Marianas Trench, capable of autonomously deciding to follow biological anomalies while managing extreme pressure constraints.
cases.title: Autonomous Deep-Sea Drone Explorer

cases.prompt: Take a 3D model of an empty concert hall and autonomously optimize the angles of every wall and the material of every seat to ensure perfect acoustic reverberation for a symphony orchestra.
cases.title: AI-Driven Architectural Acoustics

cases.prompt: Ingest materials science databases and quantum chemistry simulations, and have the AI autonomously propose the atomic structure of 10 new alloys that have the highest probability of achieving room-temperature superconductivity.
cases.title: Automated Superconductor Discovery
